name: mtg-data
description: Magic: The Gathering tournament data and gameplay review, from the scrape through to the meta read. Four skills: mtg-tournament-analysis reads the format (meta share, win rates, matchup matrices, card-level signal), deck-check assigns archetype names and pushes them back into the numbers, vod-review breaks down your own games from an untapped.gg replay, a YouTube VOD or a pasted log, and rules-check answers rules questions by quoting the current Comprehensive Rules. Local-first: Playwright scrapers pull melee.gg and MTGO onto your own machine, and format eras keep pre-ban results out of post-ban numbers. Run setup.py once after install to build the per-format folder tree and wire up scraping.
